result.title: FARR: Forecast-Aware Residual Refinement with Matched Endpoint Evidence for Long-Horizon Time-Series Forecasting
result.summary: Large language models use auxiliary conditioning to incorporate additional information into time-series forecasts. However, auxiliary conditioning does not consistently improve accuracy and can increase forecasting error when its influence is poorly matched to the observed temporal context. We propose Forecast-Aware Residual Refinement (FARR), which learns to correct forecasts using endpoint evidence. FARR obtains a valid forecast under the standard condition and a null forecast under a predefined null condition. Their difference reveals how conditioning changes the prediction. A shared residual refiner combines this endpoint evidence with historical features to estimate the remaining error of the valid forecast. Horizon-wise gating then controls the contribution of the predicted residual to the final output. Experiments on four long-horizon forecasting benchmarks show that FARR achieves the best dataset-average MSE and MAE among the compared methods. Code will be released at https://github.com/blossomrichzyy-star/farr-forecast-aware-residual-refinement.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FARR：在标准条件下得到有效预测、在预设 null 条件下得到对照预测，以两者差值作为「端点证据」，再由共享残差精修器和逐步门控校正长时程时间序列预测误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 用有效条件与 null 条件的输出差来刻画辅助条件对预测的实际影响，并按预测步门控残差贡献，可供核查是否能迁移到 VLM 中视觉证据贡献分配与按推理步调节 latent 更新。
